structured.answer: I'm not deciding anything alone. The page says if I put in 10,000 now and 500 a month for 10 years (70,000 in total), I'd have about 86,492 ₪ at פסגות in the ticked fund 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500'. At לאומי it's about 83,396. I don't know פסגות, so I'll ask my son or the bank first.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the title and the buttons with English letters
stuck.why: It opens with 'השקעה במדד' and S&P / MSCI, not with deposits. I nearly left.

stuck.where: Screen 2, right column, the small numbers under each bank (1,057, 4,541 … 10,608)
stuck.why: I wasn't sure if that's what the bank takes from me.

stuck.where: Screens 2-4, left column, the fund list
stuck.why: It's full of red minus signs (−447, −1,268, −4,492), which scared me off every fund except the ticked one.
Whole lines in English (iShares, Vanguard, UCITS, IE00…). I got tired and stopped.

used: Title 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
The filled-in boxes: 10,000 now, 500 a month, 10 years
Right column bank list: לאומי 83,396, הבינלאומי 82,371, הפועלים 81,471, דיסקונט 79,901, מזרחי טפחות 77,695
The ticked fund name 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)'
skimmed: The 'כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500' list and its coloured stickers
The 'לא בחישוב' notes under the banks
skipped: The coloured breakdown bar at the top of screen 2 and its legend
unsure_meaning: מדד (I thought it was the price index)
קרן מחקה, קרן סל, מנוטרל מט"ח, חשיפה לדולר
The small numbers under each bank's total
'אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל': can I lose?
not_found: A plain sentence on whether I can lose money
A comparison with a regular deposit
Who פסגות is and whether it's safe
What exactly to do at my own bank

findings.what: Black background, small grey and coloured writing that's hard to read even enlarged
Red minus signs on almost every fund, which scare you off without saying what they mean
It opens with English letters and words I don't know, with nothing about safety or deposits
Too many numbers and coloured stickers in one place
It doesn't say clearly whether the final amount is certain or could go down
Doesn't explain who פסגות is, compared with the banks I know
